title: Bias depends on two common-cause links
hook: Two stated cases: explore the omitted-variable contribution to an observational slope.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the omitted-variable contribution to an observational slope affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Slope, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the omitted-variable contribution to an observational slope in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
